game.name: Gran Turismo 7
game.rules:
Unless stated otherwise per category, these are game rules that apply to all runs:

- Single Segment only.
- Editing or stitching together runs is **BANNED**.
- Tools that affect gameplay are **BANNED** (i.e.: emulation hacks, automation scripts, etc.).
- Pausing the game is **ALLOWED**, but if you have a long pause in your run, it may be rejected.
- Replays of most Level runs are **NOT ALLOWED** due to not showing appropriate HUD or information showing it's a certain type of level.  Example: Circuit Experience with the 1st/2nd/3rd place requirements on-screen as you race.  Level runs from Time Trial or Drift Trial can be submitted using replays since there are no requirements for those levels. 

**Video and Audio Rules:**

- Video proof is **REQUIRED**.
- Audio is **REQUIRED**.  Music may be turned off in-game.

If you have questions regarding rules or audio/video quality, contact one of the mods before submitting to review quality.

newsList.title: Update 1.57 - New Event Races
newsList.body:
The following has been added to the leaderboard from the 1.57 update:

Event Races:

- Sunday Cup at Brands Hatch
- European Clubman Cup 600 at Deep Forest Raceway
- Japanese FF Challenge 450 at Tokyo Expressway

If anybody has any questions feel free to message a moderator.

categories.name: Fisherman%
categories.rules:
Complete the Dirt Champions race at Fisherman's Ranch in World Circuits.

Submit IGT.

categories.name: Café
categories.rules:
Complete all original menu books from the GT Café.  There are 39 in total.  Extra menu books are excluded.

Time begins when you first press X in dialogue with Sarah and ends when crossing the finish line on the final race.

Submit RTA.

Runs must be completed from a new account.

Any extreme PP glitches (i.e.: SRT Tomahawk X to 500 PP) are **BANNED**.

categories.name: Championships
categories.rules:
Complete all 10 Championships in World Circuits.

Time begins after entering your first race and ends crossing the finish line on the final race.  Championships may be done in any order but you must complete all championships.

Submit RTA.

Runs can be from a new or existing/completed account.

Any extreme PP glitches (i.e.: SRT Tomahawk X to 500 PP) are **BANNED**.

categories.name: Circuit Experiences
categories.rules:
Complete all Sectors and 1 Lap Attacks for each track in Circuit Experience.

Time begins after entering your first Sector/1 Lap Attack and ends crossing the finish line on the final Sector/1 Lap Attack.  These may be done in any order but you must complete all Sectors and 1 Lap Attacks for each track.

Submit RTA.

Runs can be from a new or existing/completed account.

categories.name: Drift Trials
categories.rules:
Complete one lap on each track (including all layouts) in World Circuits.

Add your score from each track and submit that as your score.

Restarts on levels are **NOT** allowed and will result in a 0 score for that level.

Due to SRDC limitations, please put your score in the **TIME** field as well as the **SCORE** field.
Format your score in the time field as shown:

- **H:** First 1-3 digits of your score
- **MS:** Last 3 digits of your score

Example: If your score is 100263, you'd put 100 H, 263 MS, leaving M & S blank.
The time would look like 100 H, 00 M, 00 S, 263 MS.

If your score is under 1,000 points, just fill in the MS field.

For the score field, just put your score.  Click the "Add new value button" to input your score.

categories.name: Event Races
categories.rules:
Complete all Event Races for each track in World Circuits.

Time begins after entering your first Event Race and ends crossing the finish line on your final Event Race.  These may be done in any order but you must complete all Event Races for each track.

Submit RTA.

Runs can be from a new or existing/completed account.

categories.name: License Center
categories.rules:
Complete either a single license test or all license tests in License Center.

Time begins after selecting your first license test and ends crossing the line on your final license test.  Licenses can be done in any order but you must complete all licenses.

Submit RTA.

Runs can be from a new or existing/completed account.

categories.name: Missions
categories.rules:
Complete either a set of missions or all missions in Missions Mode.

Time begins after selecting your first mission and ends crossing the line on your final mission.  Missions can be done in any order but you must complete all missions.

Submit RTA.

Runs can be from a new or existing/completed account.

All Classic Missions is missions from game release (excludes The Human Comedy).

All Missions includes all missions to-date.

Any extreme PP glitches (i.e.: SRT Tomahawk X to 500 PP) are **BANNED**.

categories.name: Music Rally
categories.rules:
Complete either one or all music rallies with bronze or better.  Failing a rally will disqualify the run.

Submit your distance in the **TIME** field.

-Example: 8,512m = 8s 512ms.

For All Music Rallies, add your distance for all of the combined and submit in the **TIME** field.  Music rallies can be completed in any order but you must complete all the rallies.

All Classic Rallies is rallies from game release (first 6 only).

All Rallies includes all rallies to-date.

It is preferred to have your units set to "km" before you start the run.  This will measure the distance in meters (m) and is more accurate than miles.  You can change this in Options > Global > Units.  If you do not do this we will convert miles to meters, which could result in a lower than expected distance due to rounding.

Audio is **NOT** required for these runs since you are unable to turn the music off.  Having music on can cause issues with VODs, monetization, etc., so it is preference to have audio or not for these.

categories.name: Time Trials
categories.rules:

Time begins after entering your first track and ends crossing the finish line on your final track.  These may be done in any order but you must complete all tracks.

games.name: Gran Turismo 7
games.rules:
Unless stated otherwise per category, these are game rules that apply to all runs:

- Single Segment only.
- Editing or stitching together runs is **BANNED**.
- Tools that affect gameplay are **BANNED** (i.e.: emulation hacks, automation scripts, etc.).
- Pausing the game is **ALLOWED**, but if you have a long pause in your run, it may be rejected.
- Replays of most Level runs are **NOT ALLOWED** due to not showing appropriate HUD or information showing it's a certain type of level.  Example: Circuit Experience with the 1st/2nd/3rd place requirements on-screen as you race.  Level runs from Time Trial or Drift Trial can be submitted using replays since there are no requirements for those levels. 

**Video and Audio Rules:**

- Video proof is **REQUIRED**.
- Audio is **REQUIRED**.  Music may be turned off in-game.

If you have questions regarding rules or audio/video quality, contact one of the mods before submitting to review quality.

You can change this in Options > Global > Units.  If you do not do this we will convert miles to meters, which could result in a lower than expected distance due to rounding.
